title: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi – Infinite Praise
arabicFull: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
transliterationFull: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi.
translationFull: Glory be to Allah and praise is to Him, as many times as the number of His creation, in accordance with His pleasure, equal to the weight of His Throne and the ink of His words.
intro: A dhikr taught by the Prophet ﷺ that multiplies reward beyond measure.
story: The Prophet ﷺ told Juwayriyyah (RA) that saying this dhikr three times outweighs hours of continuous remembrance. It expands praise beyond countable limits.
benefits: Expands your praise beyond human limitation
Reminds you of Allah's infinite greatness

phrases.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise is to Him
As many as His creation
In accordance with His pleasure
Equal to the weight of His Throne
And the ink of His words

questions.question: Who was this dhikr taught to?
questions.answer: Juwayriyyah (RA)
questions.explanation: The Prophet ﷺ taught it to her as a more weighty form of remembrance.

questions.question: What does 'Adada khalqihi' mean?
questions.answer: As many as His creation.
questions.explanation: It makes your praise limitless.

questions.question: What does this dhikr teach about Allah's greatness?
questions.answer: That His greatness and words are infinite.
questions.explanation: It links praise to infinite measures.

title: Allahu Akbar Kabira – Abundant Praise
arabicFull: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
transliterationFull: Allahu Akbar kabira, walhamdulillahi kathira, wa subhanallahi bukratan wa asila.
translationFull: Allah is truly Great, praise be to Allah in abundance, and glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening.
intro: A powerful form of glorification combining takbir, tahmid, and tasbih.
story: This dhikr was recited by a companion in salah, and the Prophet ﷺ approved of it and praised its beauty.
benefits: Combines three powerful forms of praise
Perfect for morning and evening remembrance

phrases.meaning: Allah is truly Great
Praise be to Allah abundantly
Glory be to Allah morning and evening

questions.question: What three types of praise are combined here?
questions.answer: Takbir, Tahmid, and Tasbih.
questions.explanation: It includes Allahu Akbar, Alhamdulillah, and SubhanAllah.

questions.question: When does the dua mention glorifying Allah?
questions.answer: Morning and evening.
questions.explanation: Bukratan wa asila.

questions.question: Why is combining forms of praise powerful?
questions.answer: It strengthens different dimensions of remembrance.
questions.explanation: Each form reflects a different aspect of worship.

inSalah: During opening supplication in voluntary prayers

title: Allahumma Rabbana Laka al-Hamd – Filling the Heavens
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ
transliterationFull: Allahumma Rabbana laka al-hamd mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ard wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'd.
translationFull: O Allah, our Lord, to You is the praise as much as fills the heavens, the earth, and whatever You will beyond that.
intro: A powerful praise recited after rising from ruku' in salah.
story: This dhikr was recited by a companion in prayer and the Prophet ﷺ mentioned that angels raced to record it.

phrases.meaning: O Allah, our Lord, to You belongs all praise
As much as fills the heavens
And fills the earth

phrases.arabic: وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ
phrases.transliteration: Wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'd
phrases.meaning: And whatever You will beyond that

questions.question: When is this dhikr recited in salah?
questions.answer: After rising from ruku'.
questions.explanation: It follows 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah'.

questions.question: What fills the heavens and earth?
questions.answer: Praise of Allah.
questions.explanation: The dua magnifies gratitude.

questions.question: What does this teach about gratitude?
questions.answer: That praise should be limitless.
questions.explanation: It connects gratitude to the vastness of creation.

inSalah: After rising from ruku' in obligatory and voluntary prayers

title: 🌿 Allahumma A'inni 'ala Dhikrika – Help Me Worship You Well
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّيْ عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliterationFull: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatika.
translationFull: **O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You in the best manner.**
intro: 🤍 **A powerful and deeply personal dua** the Prophet ﷺ lovingly advised to be recited after every salah.
story:
📖 The Prophet ﷺ took Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) by the hand and said:

"By Allah, I love you."

Then he said:

**Do not forget to say after every prayer:**

Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatika.

Source: Sunnah.com – Abu Dawud 1522
benefits: 🤲 **Builds gratitude and remembrance** in daily life

phrases.meaning: **O Allah, help me**
**To remember You**
**And to thank You**
**And to worship You beautifully**

questions.question: Which companion was directly advised to recite this dua?
questions.answer: **Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA)**
questions.explanation: The Prophet ﷺ personally advised him never to leave it after prayer.

questions.question: What three things does this dua ask for?
questions.answer: **Remembrance, gratitude, and excellent worship.**
questions.explanation: Dhikr (remembrance), shukr (gratitude), and husn al-'ibadah (beautiful worship).

questions.question: Why does this dua begin with asking for help?
questions.answer: **Because we cannot worship properly without Allah’s assistance.**
questions.explanation: It reflects humility, dependence, and sincerity.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Tahhir Qalbi – Purify My Heart
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ النِّفَاقِ وَعَمَلِي مِنَ الرِّيَاءِ وَلِسَانِي مِنَ الْكَذِبِ وَعَيْنِي مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ
transliterationFull: Allahumma tahhir qalbi minan-nifaq, wa 'amali minar-riya', wa lisani minal-kadhib, wa 'ayni minal-khiyanah, fa innaka ta'lamu kha'inatal-a'yuni wa ma tukhfis-sudur.
translationFull: **O Allah, purify my heart from hypocrisy, my deeds from showing off, my tongue from lying, and my eyes from betrayal. Indeed, You know the betrayal of the eyes and what the hearts conceal.**
intro: 🤍 **A powerful supplication for sincerity and inner purification.**
story:
📖 This supplication reflects deep awareness of hidden sins. It acknowledges that Allah knows what is concealed in hearts and even the subtle betrayal of the eyes.

**The final phrase comes from the Qur’an (Surah Ghafir 40:19):
"He knows the betrayal of the eyes and what the hearts conceal."**

phrases.meaning: **O Allah, purify my heart from hypocrisy**
**And my deeds from showing off**
And my tongue from lying
**And my eyes from betrayal**

phrases.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ
phrases.transliteration: Fa innaka ta'lamu kha'inatal-a'yuni wa ma tukhfis-sudur
phrases.meaning: **Indeed, You know the betrayal of the eyes and what the hearts conceal**

questions.question: What four things does this dua ask to purify?
questions.answer: **Heart, deeds, tongue, and eyes.**
questions.explanation: It targets both internal sincerity and external behavior.

questions.question: What does 'riya' mean?
questions.answer: **Showing off in worship.**
questions.explanation: It is performing deeds to be seen or praised by people rather than for Allah.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about Allah’s knowledge?
questions.answer: **That Allah knows even hidden glances and concealed intentions.**
questions.explanation: It ends by affirming Allah’s complete awareness.

inSalah: 🤲 Before concluding salah in the final sitting

title: 🌿 Subhanaka Allahumma – Opening Praise After Takbir
arabicFull: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
transliterationFull: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruk.
translationFull: Glory be to You O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your Name, Exalted is Your Majesty, and there is no deity besides You.
intro: One of the beautiful opening supplications (Du'a al-Istiftah) recited immediately after the opening Takbir before Surah al-Fatiha.
story:
Aishah (RA) reported that when the Prophet ﷺ began prayer, he would open with words of glorification and praise like this. 

Before asking for anything… he praised.
Before reciting Qur'an… he purified the heart with Tawheed.

This shows us that salah begins not with requests — but with recognition.
benefits: 🕊️ Begins prayer with glorification instead of requests
📿 Trains the tongue in praise before asking

phrases.meaning: Glory be to You O Allah, and praise
Blessed is Your Name and Exalted is Your Majesty
There is no deity besides You

questions.question: Why does this dua begin with glorification before asking for anything?
questions.answer: Because proper worship begins with recognizing Allah’s perfection.
questions.explanation: It trains the heart to praise before requesting.

questions.question: What core belief is reinforced at the end of this dua?
questions.answer: Tawheed — that there is no deity besides Allah.
questions.explanation: It closes with complete affirmation of Oneness.

questions.question: What psychological benefit does this opening create?
questions.answer: It calms the mind and anchors attention before Qur’an recitation.
questions.explanation: Praise prepares the heart to receive guidance.

title: 🌿 Allahu Akbar Kabira – Words the Angels Raced For
arabicFull: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
transliterationFull: Allahu akbaru kabira, walhamdu lillahi kathira, wa subhanallahi bukratan wa asila.
translationFull: Allah is the Greatest, immensely Great. All praise is for Allah in abundance. Glory be to Allah morning and evening.
intro: A powerful opening supplication recited after Takbir before Surah al-Fatiha.
story:
A companion entered prayer and recited these words. After the prayer, the Prophet ﷺ said: 

'I saw more than thirty angels racing to record which of them would write it first.' (Sahih Muslim 601)

This shows that spontaneous sincere glorification is beloved in the sight of Allah.
benefits: 🕊️ Multiplies praise at the start of prayer
✨ Expands takbeer beyond a single phrase

phrases.meaning: Allah is the Greatest, immensely Great
All praise is for Allah in abundance
Glory be to Allah morning and evening

questions.question: What makes this dua unique among opening supplications?
questions.answer: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned angels racing to record it.
questions.explanation: It highlights the immense reward of sincere praise.

questions.question: What three core elements does this dua contain?
questions.answer: Takbeer, praise, and glorification.
questions.explanation: It combines Allahu Akbar, Alhamdulillah, and SubhanAllah.

questions.question: What does this teach about voluntary words in prayer?
questions.answer: Sincere spontaneous praise is accepted and rewarded.
questions.explanation: The companion’s words were not rejected — they were honored.

title: 🌿 Subboohun Quddoos – Lord of the Angels and the Spirit
arabicFull: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliterationFull: Subboohun Quddoosun Rabbul malaa'ikati war-rooh.
translationFull: Perfectly Glorified, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
intro: A profound glorification recited by the Prophet ﷺ during rukūʿ and sujūd.
story:
Aishah (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ would say in his bowing and prostration: 

'Subboohun Quddoosun Rabbul malaa'ikati war-rooh.' (Sahih Muslim 487)

Even at the lowest physical position, he emphasized Allah’s absolute purity.
benefits: 🕊️ Connects the worshipper to the unseen world of angels
✨ Elevates the quality of rukūʿ and sujūd

phrases.meaning: Perfectly Glorified and Most Holy
Lord of the angels and the Spirit (Jibreel)

questions.question: Why is Allah described as Subbooh and Quddoos in rukūʿ and sujūd?
questions.answer: Because these positions reflect humility before Allah’s perfection.
questions.explanation: The lower the body, the greater the recognition of His holiness.

questions.question: Who is referred to as 'the Spirit' (ar-Rooh)?
questions.answer: Angel Jibreel (Gabriel).
questions.explanation: He is specifically honored among the angels.

questions.question: What spiritual effect does this dhikr create?
questions.answer: It magnifies Allah’s greatness while minimizing ego.
questions.explanation: True humility grows through glorification.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Laka Raka’tu – Submission in Bowing
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي
transliterationFull: Allahumma laka raka'tu wa bika aamantu wa laka aslamtu, khasha'a laka sam'i wa basari wa mukhkhi wa 'azmi wa 'asabi.
translationFull: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I believe, and to You I submit. My hearing, sight, mind, bones and nerves humble themselves before You.
intro: A comprehensive supplication said in rukūʿ expressing full physical and spiritual submission.
story:
Ali (RA) reported that when the Prophet ﷺ bowed in prayer, he would say words similar to this, affirming belief, submission and complete bodily humility. (Sahih Muslim 771)

This shows that rukūʿ is not just posture — it is declaration.
benefits: 🤲 Trains the body to reflect inner submission

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma laka raka'tu wa bika aamantu wa laka aslamtu
phrases.meaning: O Allah, to You I bow, in You I believe and to You I submit

phrases.arabic: خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي
phrases.transliteration: Khasha'a laka sam'i wa basari wa mukhkhi wa 'azmi wa 'asabi
phrases.meaning: My hearing, sight, mind, bones and nerves humble themselves before You

questions.question: What three spiritual states are declared at the start of this dua?
questions.answer: Bowing, belief, and submission.
questions.explanation: It combines physical action with internal conviction.

questions.question: Why are body parts mentioned?
questions.answer: To emphasize total surrender.
questions.explanation: Submission is not symbolic — it is complete.

questions.question: How does this improve rukūʿ?
questions.answer: It transforms bowing into conscious humility.
questions.explanation: Awareness increases presence.

title: 🌿 Subhanaka Rabbana – Glorification with Forgiveness
arabicFull: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliterationFull: Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li.
translationFull: Glory be to You O Allah, our Lord, and praise. O Allah, forgive me.
intro: A dua frequently recited by the Prophet ﷺ in rukūʿ and sujūd near the end of his life.
story:
After Surah An-Nasr was revealed, Aishah (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ would frequently say this in his bowing and prostration. (Bukhari 794; Muslim 484)

It reflected his obedience to the command: “Glorify your Lord and seek His forgiveness.”
benefits: 🕊️ Encourages repentance even at spiritual peak

phrases.meaning: Glory be to You O Allah, our Lord, and praise
O Allah, forgive me

questions.question: What Qur’anic instruction does this dua reflect?
questions.answer: Glorify your Lord and seek His forgiveness.
questions.explanation: It directly fulfills Surah An-Nasr.

questions.question: Why combine praise with forgiveness?
questions.answer: Because humility follows recognition of greatness.
questions.explanation: The more we glorify Allah, the more we see our need for forgiveness.

questions.question: What does this teach about spiritual maturity?
questions.answer: Even at the highest level, repentance continues.
questions.explanation: The Prophet ﷺ increased in seeking forgiveness.

title: 🌿 Rabbana wa Lakal Hamd – Abundant Praise After Rising
arabicFull: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
transliterationFull: Rabbana wa lakal hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih.
translationFull: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise — abundant, pure and blessed praise.
intro: A powerful praise recited after rising from rukūʿ.
story:
A companion said this after rising from rukūʿ. The Prophet ﷺ later said he saw over thirty angels rushing to record it first. (Bukhari 799)

Praise after effort is beloved.

phrases.meaning: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise
Abundant, pure and blessed praise

questions.question: What makes this version superior to the minimal wording?
questions.answer: It expands praise in quality and quantity.
questions.explanation: It adds abundant, pure and blessed.

questions.question: When is this recited?
questions.answer: After rising from rukūʿ.
questions.explanation: It follows 'Sami'Allahu liman hamidah'.

questions.question: What lesson does this teach?
questions.answer: Do more than the minimum when you can.
questions.explanation: Extra praise brings extra reward.

title: 🌿 Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi – Constant Repentance
arabicFull: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliterationFull: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.
translationFull: Glory be to Allah and praise Him. I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him.
intro: A dhikr frequently recited by the Prophet ﷺ, especially toward the end of his life.
story:
Aishah (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ would often say: 

'Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.' (Bukhari 6307; Muslim 2702)

After Surah An-Nasr was revealed, he increased in glorification and repentance — even though he was already forgiven.
benefits: ✨ Follows prophetic practice near the end of his life

phrases.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise Him
I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him

questions.question: Why did the Prophet ﷺ increase in this dhikr near the end of his life?
questions.answer: Because Surah An-Nasr instructed glorification and seeking forgiveness.
questions.explanation: It reflects obedience even at the peak of success.

questions.question: What two acts are combined in this dhikr?
questions.answer: Glorification and repentance.
questions.explanation: Tasbeeh softens the heart; istighfar purifies it.

questions.question: What does this teach about spiritual growth?
questions.answer: The closer you are to Allah, the more you seek forgiveness.
questions.explanation: Awareness increases humility.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Ighfir Li Dhanbi Kullahu – Complete Forgiveness
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
transliterationFull: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrahu.
translationFull: O Allah, forgive all my sins — small and great, first and last, open and secret.
intro: A comprehensive dua taught by the Prophet ﷺ covering every category of sin.
story:
The Prophet ﷺ would supplicate in sujood and in prayer asking for forgiveness in this complete manner. (Sahih Muslim 483)

This dua leaves no sin unmentioned — intentional or accidental.

phrases.meaning: O Allah, forgive all my sins

phrases.arabic: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
phrases.transliteration: Diqqahu wa jillahu wa awwalahu wa akhirahu wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrahu
phrases.meaning: Small and great, first and last, open and secret

questions.question: Why list multiple categories of sin?
questions.answer: To ensure nothing is excluded from repentance.
questions.explanation: It prevents selective remorse.

questions.question: When is the best time to say this?
questions.answer: In sujood or before salam.
questions.explanation: Those are moments of closeness.

questions.question: What psychological benefit does this create?
questions.answer: Relief through complete surrender.
questions.explanation: It lifts hidden burdens.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Ighfir Li Warhamni – Between the Two Sujood
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
transliterationFull: Allahummaghfir li warhamni wa 'afini wahdini warzuqni.
translationFull: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me well-being, guide me and provide for me.
intro: A balanced supplication covering forgiveness, mercy, health, guidance and provision.
story:
The Prophet ﷺ taught companions to recite this between the two prostrations. (Abu Dawud 850; Tirmidhi 284)

It connects dunya and akhirah needs in one simple plea.
benefits: 🌿 Covers both spiritual and worldly needs
🤲 Reinforces reliance between acts of humility

phrases.meaning: O Allah forgive me and have mercy on me
Grant me well-being, guide me and provide for me

questions.question: Why is this dua recited between two sujood?
questions.answer: Because it is a pause for asking between two acts of humility.
questions.explanation: It balances movement with supplication.

questions.question: What makes this dua comprehensive?
questions.answer: It covers forgiveness, mercy, health, guidance and provision.
questions.explanation: It addresses spiritual and worldly needs.

questions.question: What does this teach about dua structure?
questions.answer: Ask for both forgiveness and forward growth.
questions.explanation: It doesn’t stop at repentance.

title: 🌿 Protection from Hell, Grave & Dajjal
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min 'adhabil qabr, wa min fitnatil mahya wal mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil masihid-dajjal.
translationFull: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell, the punishment of the grave, the trials of life and death, and from the evil trial of the False Messiah.
intro: A protection dua the Prophet ﷺ consistently taught before ending prayer.
story:
The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge from these four matters in every prayer before salam. (Bukhari 1377; Muslim 588)

He emphasized this so strongly that companions considered it essential knowledge.
benefits: 🛡 Protection from the greatest unseen dangers

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam wa min 'adhabil qabr
phrases.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from Hell and the punishment of the grave

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
phrases.transliteration: Wa min fitnatil mahya wal mamat wa min sharri fitnatil masihid-dajjal
phrases.meaning: From the trials of life and death and from the trial of the False Messiah

questions.question: Why are these four specifically mentioned?
questions.answer: Because they are the most severe trials affecting eternal outcome.
questions.explanation: They impact the hereafter directly.

questions.question: When is this recited?
questions.answer: Before salam in final tashahhud.
questions.explanation: It closes prayer with protection.

title: 🌿 The Dua of Abu Bakr (RA)
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indika warhamni, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim.
translationFull: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and none forgives sins except You. So forgive me with a forgiveness from You and have mercy upon me. Indeed You are the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
intro: A deeply personal dua taught specifically to Abu Bakr (RA).
story:
Abu Bakr (RA) asked the Prophet ﷺ to teach him a supplication for prayer. The Prophet ﷺ taught him this dua. (Bukhari 834; Muslim 2705)

It begins with confession before request.
benefits: 🕊 Models humility of the greatest companion

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran
phrases.meaning: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself

phrases.arabic: فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي
phrases.meaning: Forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me

questions.question: What is the first step in this dua?
questions.answer: Admitting wrongdoing.
questions.explanation: Accountability precedes forgiveness.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Aj‘al Li Nuran – Dua While Going to the Masjid
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا وَأَمَامِي نُورًا وَخَلْفِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا
transliterationFull: Allahumma aj'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi lisani nuran, wa fi sam'i nuran, wa fi basari nuran, wa min fawqi nuran, wa min tahti nuran, wa 'an yamini nuran, wa 'an yasari nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj'al li nuran.
translationFull: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight. Place light above me and below me, to my right and to my left, in front of me and behind me. O Allah, grant me light.
intro: A powerful supplication recited by the Prophet ﷺ while going out for prayer — especially Fajr.
story:
Ibn Abbas (RA) reported that he spent the night with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Prophet woke up, cleansed his teeth, performed ablution, and when the call to prayer was announced, he went out for the prayer saying this dua. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6316; Sahih Muslim 763)

Before stepping into the darkness of Fajr — he asked for light in every direction.
benefits: 🌅 Seeks guidance before stepping into the world
🕊️ Connects physical light with spiritual clarity

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma aj'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi lisani nuran
phrases.meaning: O Allah, place light in my heart and on my tongue

phrases.arabic: وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا
phrases.transliteration: Wa fi sam'i nuran wa fi basari nuran
phrases.meaning: Light in my hearing and light in my sight
And grant me light

questions.question: Why ask for light in so many directions?
questions.answer: Because guidance must surround a believer completely.
questions.explanation: Light symbolizes clarity, faith, and protection.

questions.question: When did the Prophet ﷺ say this dua?
questions.answer: While going out for prayer after wudu.
questions.explanation: It prepared him spiritually before entering the masjid.

questions.question: What does light represent in this context?
questions.answer: Guidance, clarity, and divine assistance.
questions.explanation: It is both physical and spiritual illumination.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Antas-Salam – Peace After Prayer
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliterationFull: Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
translationFull: **O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.**
benefits: 🌟 Closes prayer with recognition of Allah’s perfection
🕊️ Direct Sunnah practice after every obligatory prayer

phrases.meaning: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace
Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor

title: 🌿 La Ilaha Illallah Wahdahu – 100x Dhikr
arabicFull: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliterationFull: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
translationFull: **None has the right to be worshiped except Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things capable.**
benefits: 🌟 Equivalent to freeing slaves (when recited 100 times)

phrases.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
phrases.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah
phrases.meaning: None worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner

phrases.arabic: لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
phrases.transliteration: Lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
phrases.meaning: To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is capable of all things

title: 🌿 La Ilaha Illallah – He Gives Life and Death
arabicFull: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliterationFull: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
translationFull: **None has the right to be worshiped except Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise. He gives life and causes death and He is capable of all things.**
benefits: 🌟 Protection and reward when recited after Fajr & Maghrib
🕊️ Affirms Allah’s absolute control over life and death

phrases.arabic: لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ
phrases.transliteration: Lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu yuhyi wa yumit
phrases.meaning: To Him belongs dominion and praise; He gives life and causes death

title: 🌿 Allahumma Allif Bayna Qulubina – Reconcile Our Hearts
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلاَمِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
transliterationFull: Allahumma allif bayna qulubina wa aslih dhata baynina wahdina subul as-salam wa najjina minaz-zulumati ila an-nur wa jannibna al-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batan wa barik lana fi asma'ina wa absarina wa qulubina wa azwajina wa dhurriyyatina wa tub 'alayna innaka Anta at-Tawwab ar-Rahim waj'alna shakireena li ni'matika muthneena biha qabiliha wa atimaha 'alayna.
translationFull: O Allah, bring our hearts together, reconcile between us, guide us to ways of peace, and deliver us from darkness into light. Keep us away from immorality, outwardly and inwardly, and bless us in our hearing, our seeing, our hearts, our spouses, and our children. Accept our repentance, for You alone are the Relenting, the Merciful. Make us grateful for Your blessings, praising and accepting them, and complete them upon us.
intro: 🤍 A comprehensive dua for unity, reconciliation, and blessing within marriage and family.
story: 📖 This supplication gathers together requests for unity of hearts, guidance, protection from sin, barakah in family, repentance, gratitude, and completion of blessings. It reflects that true marital harmony requires divine help at every level — emotional, spiritual, and moral.
benefits: 🛡 Seeks protection from hidden and open sins
👨‍👩‍👧 Brings barakah to marriage and children
💛 Builds gratitude and repentance within the home

phrases.meaning: O Allah, reconcile our hearts
And mend what is between us
Guide us to the paths of peace
Save us from darkness into light

phrases.arabic: وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
phrases.transliteration: Wa jannibna al-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batan
phrases.meaning: Keep us away from immorality outward and inward

phrases.arabic: وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا
phrases.transliteration: Wa barik lana fi asma'ina wa absarina wa qulubina wa azwajina wa dhurriyyatina
phrases.meaning: Bless our hearing, our sight, our hearts, our spouses, and our children

phrases.arabic: وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
phrases.transliteration: Wa tub 'alayna innaka Anta at-Tawwab ar-Rahim
phrases.meaning: Accept our repentance; You are the Most Accepting, Most Merciful

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
phrases.transliteration: Waj'alna shakireena li ni'matika muthneena biha qabiliha wa atimaha 'alayna
phrases.meaning: Make us grateful for Your blessings, praising them, accepting them, and complete them upon us

questions.question: What is the first thing this dua asks Allah to reconcile?
questions.answer: Our hearts.
questions.explanation: True marital peace begins with aligned hearts.

questions.question: What does 'Subul as-Salam' mean?
questions.answer: The paths of peace.
questions.explanation: It asks Allah to guide the relationship toward harmony.

questions.question: Why does the dua include repentance and gratitude?
questions.answer: Because strong marriages require humility and thankfulness.
questions.explanation: It shows that unity depends on spiritual growth.

outsideSalah: 👨‍👩‍👧 When making dua for family unity

title: 🌿 Salawat Ibrahimiyyah – Upon Muhammad and His Family
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliterationFull: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala aali Muhammad kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahim wa 'ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala aali Muhammad kama barakta 'ala Ibrahim wa 'ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid.
translationFull: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
intro: 🤍 The salawat recited in the final tashahhud of every salah.
story: 📖 The companions asked the Prophet ﷺ how to send blessings upon him. He taught them this form, known as Salawat Ibrahimiyyah. It is recited in every prayer before concluding with salam.
benefits: 🌟 Essential part of the final tashahhud in salah
💛 Brings ten blessings from Allah for each salawat
🤲 Strengthens love for the Prophet ﷺ
🕊 Connects us to the legacy of Ibrahim (AS)

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala aali Muhammad
phrases.meaning: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

phrases.arabic: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
phrases.transliteration: Kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahim wa 'ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid
phrases.meaning: As You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala aali Muhammad
phrases.meaning: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

phrases.arabic: كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
phrases.transliteration: Kama barakta 'ala Ibrahim wa 'ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid
phrases.meaning: As You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious

questions.question: When is this salawat recited in salah?
questions.answer: During the final tashahhud before salam.
questions.explanation: It is recited after tashahhud and before concluding the prayer.

questions.question: How many blessings does Allah send upon someone who sends salawat once?
questions.answer: Ten blessings.
questions.explanation: Authentic hadith mention that Allah sends ten blessings in return.

questions.question: Why is Ibrahim (AS) mentioned in this salawat?
questions.answer: To connect the legacy of Muhammad ﷺ with Ibrahim (AS).
questions.explanation: Both are leaders of pure monotheism and foundational prophets.

inSalah: 🕌 In the final tashahhud before salam
🤲 In every obligatory and voluntary prayer

title: 🌿 Salawat – Upon Muhammad, His Wives and Offspring
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliterationFull: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama sallayta 'ala aali Ibrahim. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama barakta 'ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid.
translationFull: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his offspring as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim. O Allah, bless Muhammad and his wives and his offspring as You blessed the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
intro: 🤍 A variation of salawat including the wives and offspring of the Prophet ﷺ.
story: 📖 This form of salawat emphasizes love and respect for the family of the Prophet ﷺ, including his wives and descendants.
benefits: 💛 Encourages love for the Prophet’s household

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi
phrases.meaning: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and his wives and his offspring
As You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi
phrases.meaning: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his wives and his offspring

phrases.arabic: كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
phrases.transliteration: Kama barakta 'ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid
phrases.meaning: As You blessed the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious

questions.question: Who is included in this version of salawat?
questions.answer: His wives and offspring.
questions.explanation: It emphasizes respect and love for the Prophet’s household.

questions.question: When is sending salawat especially recommended?
questions.answer: On Fridays and after the adhan.
questions.explanation: These times carry increased reward in authentic narrations.

questions.question: What does sending salawat strengthen?
questions.answer: Love and connection to the Prophet ﷺ.
questions.explanation: It deepens spiritual attachment and brings divine blessings.

inSalah: 🕌 In the final tashahhud before salam

title: Allahumma Inni A'udhu Bika – Protection from Useless Knowledge
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha.
translationFull: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
intro: A powerful supplication seeking protection from four spiritual dangers.
story: The Prophet ﷺ regularly made this dua, teaching us that knowledge alone is not enough — it must transform the heart, discipline the soul, and strengthen our connection with Allah.

phrases.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You
From knowledge that does not benefit
From a heart that does not humble itself
From a soul that is never satisfied

phrases.transliteration: Wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha
phrases.meaning: From a supplication that is not answered

questions.question: What four things does this dua seek protection from?
questions.answer: Useless knowledge, a heart without humility, an unsatisfied soul, and an unanswered dua.
questions.explanation: It protects the mind, heart, desires, and spiritual connection.

questions.question: Why is knowledge mentioned first?
questions.answer: Because knowledge shapes everything else.
questions.explanation: If knowledge does not benefit, the heart and actions follow incorrectly.

questions.question: What is the connection between the heart and answered dua?
questions.answer: A humble heart strengthens the sincerity of supplication.
questions.explanation: Khushūʿ brings closeness to Allah.

title: Allahumma Anfa'ni – Grant Me Beneficial Knowledge
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَارْزُقْنِي عِلْمًا تَنْفَعُنِي بِهِ
transliterationFull: Allahumma anfa'ni bima 'allamtani wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni warzuqni 'ilman tanfa'uni bihi.
translationFull: O Allah, benefit me through what You have taught me, teach me what benefits me, and grant me knowledge that will benefit me.
intro: A beautiful dua asking Allah to make knowledge transformative and beneficial.
story:
The Prophet ﷺ did not just ask for knowledge — he asked for knowledge that benefits. This teaches us that not all knowledge is equal.

Three Types of Knowledge:

🟢 Beneficial Knowledge (ʿIlm Nāfiʿ)
Knowledge that strengthens faith, improves character, and brings benefit in this life and the next.

🔴 Harmful Knowledge
Knowledge that distances a person from Allah, fuels arrogance, or is used for wrongdoing.

🕰 Useless Knowledge
Knowledge that neither benefits nor directly harms, but too much of it distracts from what truly matters.

This dua is a conscious request to seek only the knowledge that transforms the heart and brings closeness to Allah.
benefits: 🤲 Connects education with reliance on Allah

phrases.meaning: O Allah, benefit me through what You have taught me
And teach me what benefits me
And grant me knowledge that benefits me

questions.question: What type of knowledge does this dua emphasize?
questions.answer: Beneficial knowledge.
questions.explanation: It repeats the concept of benefit three times.

questions.question: Why is benefit mentioned repeatedly?
questions.answer: To show that knowledge must transform actions and character.
questions.explanation: Information alone is not success.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about humility in learning?
questions.answer: That knowledge is granted by Allah.
questions.explanation: It begins and ends by asking Allah.

title: Allahumma Inni As'aluka – Beneficial Knowledge, Pure Rizq, Accepted Deeds
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an wa rizqan tayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
translationFull: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.
intro: A powerful morning dua combining knowledge, provision, and action.
story:
It was narrated from Umm Salamah (RA) that after completing the Subh (Fajr) prayer and saying the salam, the Prophet ﷺ would recite this dua.

🌅 He began his day with intention.

🧠 Beneficial knowledge.
🌿 Pure and halal provision.
✨ Deeds that are accepted.

This teaches us that true success is not measured by how much we learn or earn, but by whether our knowledge transforms us, our provision is pure, and our actions are accepted by Allah.
benefits: 🌿 Asks for halal and pure provision
✨ Focuses on accepted deeds, not just actions
🤲 Builds reliance on Allah every morning
📖 Creates balance between learning and living

phrases.meaning: O Allah, I ask You
For beneficial knowledge
And pure provision
And accepted deeds

questions.question: When did the Prophet ﷺ recite this dua?
questions.answer: After Fajr prayer.
questions.explanation: It sets intention for the entire day.

questions.question: What three things are requested in this dua?
questions.answer: Beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.
questions.explanation: It combines mind, sustenance, and action.

questions.question: Why is accepted deeds mentioned instead of just deeds?
questions.answer: Because acceptance matters more than quantity.
questions.explanation: Sincerity determines value.

outsideSalah: At the start of the day

title: La Ilaha Illa Anta – Dua of Yunus (AS)
arabicFull: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliterationFull: La ilaha illa Anta, subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
translationFull: There is no deity except You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I was among the wrongdoers.
intro: A powerful Qur’anic supplication for relief and firmness in faith.
story: This dua appears in Surah Al-Anbiya (21:87). When Prophet Yunus (AS) was inside the whale, surrounded by layers of darkness — the night, the sea, and the belly of the whale — he made this supplication. It combines pure tawhid, glorification, and sincere repentance. In the next verse (21:88), Allah says He rescued him and saves the believers in this way.

phrases.meaning: There is no deity except You; Glory be to You
Indeed, I was among the wrongdoers

questions.question: In which Surah does this dua appear?
questions.answer: Surah Al-Anbiya (21:87).
questions.explanation: It is part of the story of Prophet Yunus (AS).

questions.question: What three elements does this dua combine?
questions.answer: Tawhid, glorification, and repentance.
questions.explanation: It affirms Allah, praises Him, and admits wrongdoing.

questions.question: What promise follows this dua?
questions.answer: Allah rescues the believers in this way (21:88).
questions.explanation: It is a model for relief through sincerity.

title: Allahu Allahu Rabbi – Firm Tawhid
arabicFull: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
transliterationFull: Allahu Allahu Rabbi, la ushriku bihi shay'an.
translationFull: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
intro: A powerful declaration of pure tawhid in times of fear or hardship.
story: The Prophet ﷺ taught that whoever says this supplication in times of distress or fear, Allah will relieve him. It is a direct affirmation of exclusive devotion to Allah, rejecting all forms of shirk and strengthening one's reliance upon Him.
benefits: 🌊 Brings calm during fear or anxiety
✨ Protects from subtle forms of shirk

phrases.meaning: Allah, Allah is my Lord
I do not associate anything with Him

questions.question: What core belief does this dua affirm?
questions.answer: Pure tawhid (oneness of Allah).
questions.explanation: It declares that nothing is associated with Allah.

questions.question: When is this dua especially powerful?
questions.answer: During fear or distress.
questions.explanation: It strengthens reliance on Allah alone.

questions.question: What does 'La ushriku bihi shay'an' protect from?
questions.answer: Associating partners with Allah.
questions.explanation: It reinforces exclusive worship.

title: Allahumma Inni A'udhu Bika – Protection from Kufr and the Grave
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr. La ilaha illa Anta.
translationFull: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no deity except You.
intro: A powerful supplication seeking protection from disbelief and punishment of the grave.
story: The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge in Allah from disbelief and from the punishment of the grave. This dua reminds the believer that true poverty is loss of faith, and true safety is protection in the Hereafter.
benefits: 🤍 Strengthens faith and reliance on Allah
⚰️ Reminds of the reality of the grave

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr
phrases.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
phrases.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave
There is no deity except You

questions.question: What two major dangers does this dua seek protection from?
questions.answer: Disbelief and punishment of the grave.
questions.explanation: It protects both faith in this life and safety in the next.

questions.question: Why is disbelief mentioned before poverty?
questions.answer: Because loss of faith is the greatest loss.
questions.explanation: Spiritual poverty is more dangerous than material poverty.

questions.question: Why does the dua end with tawhid?
questions.answer: Because ultimate safety lies in affirming the oneness of Allah.
questions.explanation: Tawhid is the foundation of protection.

title: Rabbana Zalamna – Dua of Adam (AS)
arabicFull: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
transliterationFull: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa illam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
translationFull: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
intro: The first recorded dua of repentance in the Qur’an.
story: After Adam (AS) and Hawwa (AS) ate from the forbidden tree, they did not blame Shaytan or make excuses. Instead, they immediately turned to Allah in humility. This dua shows that firmness in faith is not perfection — it is returning to Allah after mistakes.

phrases.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves

phrases.transliteration: Wa illam taghfir lana wa tarhamna
phrases.meaning: And if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us
We will surely be among the losers

questions.question: Who made this dua?
questions.answer: Adam (AS) and Hawwa (AS).
questions.explanation: It is the first dua of repentance recorded in the Qur’an.

questions.question: What did they admit immediately?
questions.answer: That they wronged themselves.
questions.explanation: They took responsibility without blaming others.

questions.question: What does this teach about firmness in faith?
questions.answer: That returning to Allah after sin is strength, not weakness.
questions.explanation: Faith grows through repentance.

title: Rabbana Waj'alna Muslimayn – Dua of Ibrahim (AS)
arabicFull: رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةًۭ مُّسْلِمَةًۭ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliterationFull: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
translationFull: Our Lord, make us submissive to You and from our descendants a nation submissive to You. Show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful.
intro: A Qur'anic dua for submission, righteous legacy, and sincere repentance.
story: While building the Ka'bah, Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and his son Isma'il (AS) made this powerful dua. Despite being prophets, they still asked Allah to make them truly submissive. This shows that firmness in faith is a continuous pursuit — even the righteous ask for stability and acceptance.
benefits: 🤍 Builds humility even in good deeds

phrases.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ
phrases.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka
phrases.meaning: Our Lord, make us submissive to You and from our descendants a nation submissive to You
And show us our rites and accept our repentance
Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful

questions.question: Which two prophets made this dua?
questions.answer: Ibrahim (AS) and Isma'il (AS).
questions.explanation: They made it while building the Ka'bah.

questions.question: Why did they ask to be made Muslim even though they already were?
questions.answer: Because true submission requires continual renewal.
questions.explanation: Faith is a lifelong pursuit.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about firmness in faith?
questions.answer: That stability, guidance, and repentance must always be sought.
questions.explanation: Even prophets asked for it.

title: Radiytu Billahi Rabba – Contentment with Allah
arabicFull: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا
transliterationFull: Radiytu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin rasulan.
translationFull: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad as my Messenger.
intro: A powerful declaration of contentment and spiritual acceptance.
story: The Prophet ﷺ taught that whoever says this supplication in the morning and evening with sincerity will be pleased on the Day of Judgment. It is not just a statement — it is a commitment of the heart to accept Allah’s decree, Islam’s guidance, and the Prophet ﷺ as the ultimate role model.

phrases.meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord
And with Islam as my religion
And with Muhammad as my Messenger

questions.question: When is this dua recommended to be recited?
questions.answer: In the morning and evening.
questions.explanation: It is part of daily adhkar.

questions.question: What three acceptances does this dua affirm?
questions.answer: Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as Messenger.
questions.explanation: It reinforces identity and faith.

questions.question: How does this relate to divine decree?
questions.answer: Contentment with Allah as Lord means accepting His plan.
questions.explanation: It builds spiritual surrender.

outsideSalah: When feeling unsettled about life decisions
When seeking peace in difficult situations

title: Hasbiyallahu – Trust in Allah
arabicFull: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliterationFull: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim.
translationFull: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
intro: A powerful Qur’anic declaration of reliance and trust in Allah.
story: This verse concludes Surah At-Tawbah. It teaches that when people turn away or circumstances become difficult, the believer declares complete reliance upon Allah. Saying 'Hasbiyallahu' is an affirmation that Allah alone is enough — regardless of outcomes.

phrases.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me
There is no deity except Him
Upon Him I rely
And He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne

questions.question: In which Surah does this dua appear?
questions.answer: Surah At-Tawbah (9:129).
questions.explanation: It concludes the Surah.

questions.question: What does 'Hasbiyallahu' mean?
questions.answer: Allah is sufficient for me.
questions.explanation: It expresses complete reliance.

questions.question: How does this relate to contentment with divine decree?
questions.answer: Trusting Allah removes fear of outcomes.
questions.explanation: Reliance brings inner peace.

title: Allahumma Inni A'udhu Bika – Protection from Loss of Blessings
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَأَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matika, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatika, wa fuja'ati niqmatika, wa jami'i sakhatika.
translationFull: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of Your blessings, the removal of Your protection, the sudden onset of Your punishment, and all of Your displeasure.
intro: A powerful supplication seeking protection from the loss of blessings and Allah’s displeasure.
story: The Prophet ﷺ would seek protection from the sudden loss of blessings and from Allah’s displeasure. This dua reminds us that health, security, and provision are gifts that can change. True contentment includes asking Allah to preserve His favors and protect us from sudden trials.

phrases.meaning: From the loss of Your blessing
And the change of Your protection/well-being
And the sudden onset of Your punishment
And all of Your displeasure

questions.question: What does this dua seek protection from first?
questions.answer: The loss of Allah’s blessings.
questions.explanation: It begins with awareness of ni'mah.

questions.question: What does 'tahawwul al-'afiyah' mean?
questions.answer: The removal or change of well-being.
questions.explanation: Health and safety are not guaranteed.

questions.question: How does this dua relate to contentment?
questions.answer: It teaches gratitude and fear of losing Allah’s favor.
questions.explanation: Contentment includes preserving blessings.

title: Inna Lillahi – Dua During Calamity
arabicFull: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
transliterationFull: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran منها.
translationFull: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my calamity and replace it with something better.
intro: A powerful dua for patience, reward, and divine replacement after loss.
story: The phrase 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un' appears in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:156) describing the patient believers. The Prophet ﷺ taught that whoever says this during a calamity and adds this supplication, Allah will reward them and replace their loss with something better. Umm Salamah (RA) recited it after her husband's death, and Allah replaced her loss with something better — marriage to the Prophet ﷺ.
benefits: 🕊 Calms the heart in moments of grief

phrases.meaning: Indeed we belong to Allah
And indeed to Him we will return
O Allah, reward me in my calamity
And replace it for me with something better

questions.question: In which Surah does 'Inna lillahi...' appear?
questions.answer: Surah Al-Baqarah (2:156).
questions.explanation: It describes the patient believers.

questions.question: Who is an example of someone who recited this dua?
questions.answer: Umm Salamah (RA).
questions.explanation: Allah replaced her loss with something better.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about hardship?
questions.answer: That loss can be a path to reward and replacement.
questions.explanation: Patience brings divine compensation.

title: 🌿 Protection for Children – From Shaytan
arabicFull: إِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliterationFull: Inni u'idhuha bika wa dhurriyyataha min ash-shaytan ir-rajim.
translationFull: Indeed, I seek refuge for her in You and for her offspring from Shaytan, the accursed.
intro: 🤍 A powerful Qur’anic supplication for protection of children from Shaytan.
story:
📖 This dua was made by the wife of 'Imran when she dedicated Maryam (AS) to Allah.

It appears in Surah Aal 'Imran (3:36).

The Prophet ﷺ later said that every newborn is touched by Shaytan at birth except Maryam and her son 'Isa (AS). (Sahih al-Bukhari 3431, Sahih Muslim 2366)

This shows that Allah accepted her dua in a unique and miraculous way.
benefits: 🛡 Seeks protection from Shaytan at the earliest stage of life
👶 Encourages parents to make dua for their children
🌿 Establishes reliance upon Allah for spiritual protection

phrases.meaning: Indeed, I seek refuge for her in You and for her offspring
From Shaytan, the accursed

questions.question: Who made this dua?
questions.answer: The wife of 'Imran, the mother of Maryam (AS).
questions.explanation: She made it when dedicating her daughter to Allah.

questions.question: Where is this dua found?
questions.answer: Surah Aal 'Imran (3:36).
questions.explanation: It is part of the story of Maryam’s birth.

questions.question: How did Allah respond to this dua?
questions.answer: Maryam (AS) and her son 'Isa (AS) were protected from Shaytan at birth.
questions.explanation: This is mentioned in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.

inSalah: 🕌 During sujood when making personal dua
outsideSalah: 💛 Regularly when making dua for children

title: 🌿 Rabbi Hab Li – Grant Me Righteous Offspring
arabicFull: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
transliterationFull: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah. Innaka Sami'ud-du'a.
translationFull: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a pure offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
intro: 🤍 A sincere Qur’anic dua for righteous and spiritually pure children.
story:
📖 Prophet Zakariyya (AS) made this dua after witnessing the special provision Allah granted to Maryam (AS). Seeing Allah’s power and generosity strengthened his hope.

Although he had reached old age and his wife had been barren, he did not lose hope in Allah’s ability.

He specifically asked for a pure and righteous offspring — not just a child, but one upright in faith and character.

Allah answered his dua by granting him Yahya (AS), who became a noble prophet.
benefits: 🌿 Teaches hope even when circumstances seem impossible
👶 Encourages asking for righteous, not just biological, children
🤲 Strengthens certainty that Allah hears and responds to dua
💛 Shows that sincere faith precedes divine gifts

phrases.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً
phrases.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah
phrases.meaning: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a pure and righteous offspring
Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication

questions.question: What inspired Zakariyya (AS) to make this dua?
questions.answer: Seeing Allah provide miraculously for Maryam (AS).
questions.explanation: It increased his certainty that Allah could grant him a child despite old age.

questions.question: What kind of child did he ask for?
questions.answer: A pure and righteous offspring.
questions.explanation: He prioritized faith and character over worldly benefit.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about Allah?
questions.answer: That Allah hears every sincere supplication.
questions.explanation: It ends by affirming Allah as the Hearer of dua.

inSalah: 🕌 During sujood when making personal dua
outsideSalah: 💛 When making dua for righteous offspring

title: 🌿 Protection for Children – With the Perfect Words of Allah
arabicFull: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliterationFull: U'idhukuma bi kalimatillahi at-tammah min kulli shaytanin wa hammah wa min kulli 'aynin lammah.
translationFull: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every harmful eye.
intro: 🤍 A powerful prophetic dua for protecting children from harm and evil.
story:
📖 The Prophet ﷺ used to seek protection for Hasan and Husayn (RA) with this dua.

He would say that your forefather Ibrahim (AS) used similar words when seeking protection.

This narration is recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari (3371).

It shows that spiritual protection was a consistent practice of the Prophets.

phrases.meaning: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah
From every devil and poisonous creature
And from every harmful eye

questions.question: For whom did the Prophet ﷺ recite this dua?
questions.answer: Hasan and Husayn (RA).
questions.explanation: He regularly sought protection for them using this supplication.

questions.question: What does 'kalimatillah at-tammah' mean?
questions.answer: The perfect words of Allah.
questions.explanation: It refers to Allah’s complete and flawless speech and protection.

questions.question: What harms does this dua protect from?
questions.answer: Devils, harmful creatures, and the evil eye.
questions.explanation: It covers both physical and spiritual harm.

inSalah: 🕌 During sujood when making personal dua
outsideSalah: 💛 When fearing harm or evil eye

title: 🌿 Rabbi Ij‘alni Muqim As-Salah – Make Me and My Children Steadfast in Prayer
arabicFull: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
transliterationFull: Rabbi ij'alni muqim as-salah wa min dhurriyyati. Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.
translationFull: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my offspring as well. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
intro: 🤍 A profound Qur’anic dua for steadfastness in prayer across generations.
story:
📖 Prophet Ibrahim (AS) made this dua after building the Ka‘bah and establishing worship in Makkah.

He did not only ask to perform prayer, but to be constant, firm, and upright in establishing it properly.

He also asked that his offspring be among those who establish prayer, showing that true success is generational faith.

By saying 'Our Lord, accept my supplication,' he demonstrated humility — knowing that even acts of obedience require acceptance from Allah.

This dua appears in Surah Ibrahim (14:40).
benefits: 🕌 Teaches that prayer is the foundation of faith
👨‍👩‍👧 Encourages making dua for children’s spiritual success
🌿 Emphasizes consistency in worship, not occasional practice
🤲 Shows humility in asking Allah to accept even good deeds

phrases.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي

title: 🌿 Rabbana Hablana – Make Our Families the Comfort of Our Eyes
arabicFull: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliterationFull: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yun. Waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
translationFull: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and our offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous.
intro: 🤍 A comprehensive Qur’anic dua for righteous families and spiritual leadership.
story:
📖 This dua is mentioned among the qualities of the true servants of the Most Merciful in Surah Al-Furqan (25:74).

They do not only seek personal righteousness but ask Allah to bless their spouses and children with guidance and uprightness.

'Comfort of the eyes' refers to seeing one’s family obedient to Allah, steadfast in faith, and a source of joy in this life and the Hereafter.

They also ask to become leaders for the righteous — meaning role models in piety, guidance, and good character.
benefits: 💛 Teaches that true joy comes from righteous loved ones

phrases.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا
phrases.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina
phrases.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and our offspring
Comfort and joy to our eyes
And make us leaders for the righteous

questions.question: What does 'qurrata a'yun' mean?
questions.answer: Comfort and joy to the eyes.
questions.explanation: It refers to deep happiness from seeing loved ones guided and obedient to Allah.

questions.question: What kind of leadership does this dua ask for?
questions.answer: Leadership in righteousness and piety.
questions.explanation: It seeks to become role models for the people of taqwa.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about family?
questions.answer: That true success is spiritual harmony within the home.
questions.explanation: Joy comes from faith and uprightness, not just worldly comfort.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Ighfir Dhanbahu – Dua for a Child’s Purity
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ ذَنْبَهُ وَطَهِّرْ قَلْبَهُ وَحَصِّنْ فَرْجَهُ
transliterationFull: Allahumma ighfir dhanbahu wa tahhir qalbahu wa hassin farjahu.
translationFull: O Allah, forgive his sin, purify his heart, and guard his chastity.
intro: 🤍 A powerful prophetic dua for protecting a child’s heart and chastity.
story:
📖 A young man once approached the Prophet ﷺ struggling with desire.

The Prophet ﷺ advised him gently, placed his hand on his chest, and made this dua for him.

After this supplication, the young man said that nothing was more disliked to him than immorality.

This narration is recorded in Musnad Ahmad and is authentic.

It shows that purification begins with forgiveness, then cleansing of the heart, and finally protection of actions.
benefits: 💛 Purifies the heart from harmful desires

questions.question: Why is purification of the heart mentioned?
questions.answer: Because actions follow the condition of the heart.
questions.explanation: A purified heart leads to pure behavior.

questions.question: What does guarding chastity protect?
questions.answer: Moral integrity and honor.
questions.explanation: It shields youth from destructive desires.
